ios.desc:
Stop doomscrolling. Start Dreamscrolling.

Struggling to wind down at night? Tired of falling into endless social media rabbit holes before bed?
Dreamscroll helps you build a healthier nighttime routine by replacing doomscrolling with thousands of beautiful, curated nature photographs — at your own pace, with no algorithm pulling you in.

How it works:
Simply open the app and scroll. Each photo fills your screen, letting you focus on one calming image at a time. Set a reminder, track your sessions, and build a streak — all the tools you need to make this a real bedtime habit. No infinite feeds, no algorithm chaos — just nature photography at your own pace.

What makes Dreamscroll different:
- No ads, ever: We'll never interrupt your calm with advertisements
- No data collection: All session stats stay on your device. We have no idea how you use the app, and we like it that way
- Real photography: Every photo is from real photographers on Unsplash — no AI-generated images
- Built with user-first values: No dark patterns, no data harvesting, no BS

Perfect for:
- Winding down before bed
- Building a healthier nighttime screen routine
- Taking a mindful break during the day
- Calming anxiety or stress
- People who enjoy nature photography
- Anyone who wants to satisfy their scrolling habit without the noise of social media

Download Dreamscroll and discover a more peaceful way to scroll.
